about_the_game:
ABOMINATION OPS. A cinematic sci-fi visual novel with explosive action, psychological tension, twisted lore, and bleak humor.

For years, hidden alien overlords pushed humanity to the brink of madness. Turning the modern world into a hostile pressure cooker, they even twisted our genetics to create hybrid abominations meant to serve as their enforcers.

We uncovered the plot. We fought the aliens, we won, and they fled. But they left their hybrid children behind…

Abomination Ops is a bleak, high-intensity visual novel about the abandoned hybrids—mutated, hated, barely human. Rejected by society, yet drafted into humanity’s dirtiest black ops missions. Their crime? BEING BORN.

Experience a visceral story of survival, identity, and post-alien collapse, brought to life with:

An intense, cinematic soundtrack blending synthwave, death metal, and shoegaze.

Stylish AI-assisted art and animated cutscenes.

A haunting world that merges dystopian sci-fi with early 1900s aesthetics.

Created by one human, many machines, and no committee.

This is a story that could not have been made before now.

content_descriptors.notes: Abomination Ops contains scenes not necessarily appropriate for minors, such as violence, prostitution, references to drugs and human trafficking, references to enslavement, and references to self-harm.
